player: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production VFX sprite atlas for BOB, a hand-painted 2D side-view dark underwater fantasy game. Genuine transparent background. Canvas square, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells, no lines or text. Each row is a separate effect with FOUR consecutive distinct animation phases left to right: onset, contact peak, spreading breakup, sparse dying fragments. All four cells use same center and pixel scale, 12% clear gutter inside each cell. Row1: narrow ivory and muted teal weapon slash, traveling diagonally downward from upper left to lower right, hollow arc, no filled disk. Row2: return combo slash rising from lower left to upper right, two thin tapered strokes, slightly more energetic than row1. Row3: heavy resonator strike, broken hollow crescent with a few ivory shell shards, strong but local; no full opaque ring. Row4: tiny contact burst of 5-9 ivory and warm amber shell chips with thin teal strokes, no fire, no smoke blanket. Delicate painterly gouache edges, restrained bioluminescence, no neon or excessive bloom. Effects ONLY, no character, no scenery, no weapons, no checkerboard. Most of every cell must be transparent, the player and enemy must stay readable through the empty center. Four true changing poses per row, with final frames clearly dissipating. Save the generated image normally; this is a project asset.
crab: Use case: stylized-concept. One production animated VFX sprite atlas for BOB, hand-painted side-view dark underwater fantasy game. Genuine transparent RGBA background. Square canvas, EXACT equal 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 isolated cells, no labels or borders. All cells with at least 10 percent transparent inner margin. Four successive animation phases per row left to right: onset, peak, spreading, dissipated sparse remains. Each effect shares a fixed pixel scale and anchor within its row. Row1: low sweeping claw wake, thin horizontal curling grey-teal sediment streak with a FEW ivory grit particles, sweeping left to right, mostly empty space, local and ground hugging. Row2: heavy ground impact, short fan of ivory bone chips and muted warm ochre dust, emerging from bottom-center at y=80 percent of cell. Low plume only, not tall smoke. Row3: running crab ground dust puff, short loose curved grey ochre sediment thrown LEFT from bottom center, low and small, distinct expanding/disintegrating puffs, not fire or explosions. Row4: uplifting resonance of small warm amber and pale teal bioluminescent motes around a broken hollow ellipse, airy celebratory but restrained. Four phases tiny motes, brief thin halo, rising separated motes, sparse dying motes. Huge empty center, absolutely no solid orb. Painterly gouache, ivory shell dust, subtle bioluminescence, readable small size. Effects only, NO crab, characters, ground, landscape, text, checkerboard or neon glow. Most pixels transparent. Do not cross cell boundaries.
